rules:
Fixture lists owner/code/category/retryability/path/detail keys for P12 public
codes and is changed only with API-policy compatibility review. Gate scans actual declared descriptors/
explicit ApiError codes and fails new unregistered or changed rows; dynamic values require a reviewed
fixture adapter, not suppression. Observability gate forbids ID label literals and arbitrary SDK attribute
maps outside adapter. Impersonation test uses direct `AuditLogger`, not observer. Planted failures run in
`try/finally`. Only root changelog. Record every external URL in `docs/reference.md` with purpose/date.
guidance:
Reuse P3 tokenizer/source scanner rather than regex over vendor/generated files. Keep
fixtures scalar and consumable by P13's future `errors.json` generator. Receipt has sections errors, wire,
events/logs, metrics/OTel, messaging, impersonation, zones, commands/skips/risks.

isolated PostgreSQL closure and P5 delivery health
OpenTelemetry absent boot and development adapter
serializer old-wire digest and P13 artifact exclusion
package graph, attributes architecture and provider-size closure
official reference, changelog and phase receipt

deliverables:
Three ratchet suites, stable-code fixture ready for P13 consumption, official reference
record, root release note and complete P12 receipt with negative evidence.

sections.title: Validation
sections.text:
Plant and remove: code/category drift, unregistered code, forbidden `account_id` metric
label, arbitrary OTel attributes, raw Throwable logging, direct audit bypass and unclassified core file;
each fails its named rule. Run core/api/attributes/tenancy lint/analyse/test, root Arch, P5 delivery-health
tests and isolated attributes/tenancy PG closure. Verify OTel-absent boot and OTel dev adapter lane. Verify
serializer old-wire digest and absence of P13 artifacts. Any skipped lane is explicit non-green.
